Package io.jans.lock.model.trace.entity

Class TraceRecordEntry

java.lang.Object
io.jans.orm.model.base.Entry
io.jans.orm.model.base.BaseEntry
io.jans.lock.model.trace.entity.TraceRecordEntry
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable
public class TraceRecordEntry extends io.jans.orm.model.base.BaseEntry implements Serializable
One accepted TRACE record (design §10, TRACE MVP design decision T-1). Every attribute is immutable once persisted, except the three Lock-derived correlation flags (getCoverageGap(), getChainLinkFailure(), getEquivocation()), which neighbor updates may set later (design decision D-9).
Author:
Yuriy Movchan
